BodyFillsTheRail.note: Body takes every pixel the footer leaves: nine workspace rows overflow and clip at the rail edge while the account footer stays anchored. Demonstrates min-h-0/flex-1 correctly.

BodyWithShortContent.note: Same rail with two threads — content stays top-aligned, the body still owns the column and the footer sits at the bottom.

BodyWithoutFooter.note: No footer at all; the body simply runs to the bottom of the rail. Confirms the frame's footer slot is optional.
